text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. While waiting 
for Nakayama Festa in front of the school 
gate...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you watch the Oka Sho race!? That 
favorite girl was amazing, wasn't she~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And she's got her sights set on the Arc de 
Triomphe, right? You can't help but expect 
great things from her!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, the Classic season's already 
started too~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose the whole academy gets swept 
up in excitement once the Classic season 
rolls around."
choice_data_list:
There were interview requests for you too, 
you know.

There was also an interview request for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Less as a Classic favorite, and 
more as an object of curiosity, I'd bet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be surprised if race popularity 
turns out low, even with all those 
interview requests.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Why are you registered for the Satsuki 
Sho?! You told me you wouldn't!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I told you I don't have a goal! I'm not 
aiming for the Triple Crown route!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why!? Why is it always... you guys getting 
all the...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...If there are Umamusume like me who get 
to run in the Classics, there are also 
those who don't.

—I recall an incident from February of 
this year. It happened during training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: O... owch!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan!? What's wrong—... wait. Your 
toes... what happened to them...!?

The one who rushed over to Tosen Jordan 
was the model Umamusume, Gold City. Seeing 
the state of her friend... she gasped.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, really... More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"How could you possibly be fine?! Blood is 
literally seeping through your shoes, you 
know?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you to the nurse's office. Come 
on, get on my back!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'm not going. I'm totally not 
going...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Idiot! What are you saying?! Come on, 
hurry up—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No wayyy!! Because... if that happens...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The doctor is gonna tell me I can't run in 
the race...!

—The Classic Triple Crown is a stage an 
Umamusume can only challenge once in her 
lifetime.

"Which is exactly why so many Umamusume 
set their dreams and aspirations on that 
stage, betting their entire racing careers 
on it."
choice_data_list:
(If she gets injured at a time like 
this...)

text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps it's the exact same thing as 
having your dreams put out of reach 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...A race everyone would put their lives 
on the line for, huh? ............"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just leave it at "well, I 
lost" and call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I did make a promise to the teacher, after 
all.

Upon reaching the racecourse's waiting 
room, Nakayama Festa took a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: *Inhaaaale*... ...*Pheeew*...
choice_data_list: Let's go prove what you're capable of.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's begin the bet—
